259:t_2:47.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「We can't even make a hyperspace jump for a while! What are we supposed to do!?」

259:t_2:48.en:
$$ボス$$
「W-what are we supposed to do, you say... Come on...」

259:t_2:49.en:
$$甲児$$
「All we can do is fight.」

259:t_2:51.en:
$$甲児$$
「Light is born where there is hope... All we can do now is believe in that and keep moving forward.」

259:t_2:54.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't you need to go to the others?」

259:t_2:59.en:
$n
「That voice that interfered with $$ゼウス$$'s spatial transfer... Ever since I heard it, my eyes have...」

259:t_2:60.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Bloodstained eyes... Then is that voice the 《$$テンシ$$》 you've been chasing, $n?」

259:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...You seem to be in a good mood, $$ニコラ$$.」

259:t_10:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「No way... Even I understand how serious this situation is.」

259:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is that so? When you were racking up a score against the $$宇宙怪獣$$, I could feel your heart stirring greatly, $$ニコラ$$.」

259:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thanks to that, $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z were produced. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

259:t_10:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Do what you like. I'm not particularly interested.」

259:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...May I, $$ニコラ$$...? Judging from the movement of your heart, you are, in a word...」

259:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're aiming to overtake $$ラルク$$ and take the top spot! So that everyone will call you Prince!」

259:t_10:13.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Keep this a secret from the Princess, okay? Well then...」

259:t_10:15.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Don't be so pleased with yourself, AG.」

259:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, $$カシオ$$... The background check on $$ニコラ$$ that you requested has reached a conclusion for now, hasn't it?」

259:t_10:17.en:
$$カシオ$$
「...I heard you were sensitive to the workings of the human heart, but your eyes must be knotholes.」

259:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How dare you say that! Down on my luck as I may be, this AG is still a robot, sir! You would have to say my sensors have low sensitivity!」

259:t_10:19.en:
$$カシオ$$
「...Never mind. He's at the end of the universe anyway. $$ニコラ$$ can't make a move either, I'd guess.」

259:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What exactly about $$ニコラ$$ is bothering you, $$カシオ$$?」

259:t_10:21.en:
$$カシオ$$
「...Forget it. I'm probably worrying over nothing...」

259:t_10:22.en:
$$カシオ$$
(There's a rumor he has ties with those strange people from $$タイタン$$... What on earth is $$ニコラ$$ doing with those sisters...)

259:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're worried about Lord $$ゼウス$$, aren't you, $$甲児$$?」

259:t_10:29.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$ is a god of light. I believe he'll be fine no matter what.」

259:t_10:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「What I'm thinking about is the difference between humans and gods.」

259:t_10:32.en:
$$甲児$$
「When Grandpa entrusted $$マジンガーＺ$$ to me, he said that with $$マジンガー$$'s power I could become either a god or a devil...」

259:t_10:33.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's true that $$マジンガー$$'s power can stand up on equal terms even to $$ミケーネ$$, who call themselves gods. But...」

259:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even so, you still have doubts about saying you've become a god yourself... Is that it?」

259:t_10:35.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... I don't think what they mean by god is simply a being with powerful force.」

259:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... You sense a difference in kind, not in quantity.」

259:t_10:37.en:
$$甲児$$
「AG... You're a dimensional merchant. Do you know anything?」

259:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm just a humble agent robot, so there's nothing I can tell you, but...」

259:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have heard that $$Ｚチップ$$s are the power by which people bring about a god's miracles.」

259:t_10:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「Come to think of it, during the $$時獄戦役$$... I once used the power of $$Ｚチップ$$ to call back $$ゼウス$$, who had fallen into the gap between dimensions...」

259:t_10:45.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$Ｚチップ$$ turns feelings into power... Feelings bring about miracles... For me right now, that's enough.」

259:t_10:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let me show you that my feelings can bring about a miracle.」

259:t_10:48.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The customer-calling I do day in and day out... That is my feelings... In other words, the very fact that customers come is the miracle!」

259:t_10:49.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then!! Today, too! Let's give it our alllll best! Business, business, businessss!!」

259:t_10:53.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n collapsed with a high fever. Please refrain from shouting like an idiot.」

259:t_10:55.en:
$$甲児$$
「...The road to godhood looks long, AG.」

259:t_10:56.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not necessarily. I am always waiting for a god, after all.」

259:t_10:58.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, the customer is a god, as they say.」

260:t_000:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Thank you for your hard work, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ and $$號$$.」

260:t_000:3.en:
$$凱$$
「Still, for a hyperspace jump, the scenery hasn't changed much...」

260:t_000:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then, from the center of the galaxy to Earth it's 28,000 light-years, so...」

260:t_000:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'd have to do the same thing 35,000 times.」
